title: AIxDaily
overview_zh: 今日精选：AI × Chem 14 项，AI × Bio 16 项，AI × Math 0 项，AI Voices 10 项，Engineering 6 项。今日五频道呈现“科研预印本+工程项目+公开观点”的组合：AI×化学聚焦带校准不确定性的分子性质预测、对映选择性人工金属酶及计算药物发现综述；AI×生物覆盖低样本临床预测、帕金森生物标志物和百日咳监测。化学与生物精选均为预印本，今日没有同行评议论文入选。AI Voices 汇集 X 上的基准、模型架构和教材线索，属于公开帖文；Engineering 则是 GitHub Trending 软件项目。AI×数学今日没有足够高质量更新。

channel_highlights.aixbio: 今日三项均为 medRxiv/bioRxiv 预印本，涉及低样本临床预测、帕金森血液转录组标志物和百日咳分子监测；结果仍需同行评议与前瞻性验证。
channel_highlights.aixmath: 今日 AI×数学没有足够高质量更新，未选入条目；不以旧内容或未经核实材料补足。
channel_highlights.aivoices: 今日重点来自 X 公开帖文：FrontierML 基准、受约束解码模型和一份智能体大模型教材线索；均属公开观点或书目信息，需查原始材料。
channel_highlights.engineering: 今日为 GitHub Trending 工程软件项目，非论文或正式发布公告，聚焦智能体逆向工程、实时 3D 空间情报和本地语音工作台；采用前核查安全与许可证。

items.title: Molecular Property Prediction with Well-Calibrated Uncertainties via Graph Neural Networks and Conformal Quantile Regression
items.abstract_or_text: Accurate predictive uncertainty quantification (pUQ) is critical for assessing chemical property predictions. Incorrect quantification could lead to costly synthesis and characterization of drug candidates destined to fail, or result in misguided environmental regulations. This work integrates Conformal Quantile Regression (CQR) with graph neural networks to achieve accurate molecular property prediction and well-calibrated predictive uncertainty quantification. By combining conformal prediction with quantile regression, CQR provides model-agnostic, distribution-free prediction intervals with valid coverage for finite samples. We benchmark it against established pUQ approaches, including ensembling, Monte Carlo dropout sampling, mean-variance estimation, and evidential regression. Our experiments on datasets spanning quantum mechanics, physical chemistry, and pharmacokinetics show that CQR generally provides strong calibration while maintaining competitive predictive accuracy and uncertainty-ranking performance. It also effectively captures heteroskedastic noise across the data, which is a key requirement for robust pUQ. Furthermore, we demonstrate its efficacy with an uncertainty-guided retrospective virtual screening experiment for antibiotic discovery, achieving hit rates above 90%. These results establish CQR as a promising, scalable tool for pUQ in molecular property prediction, supporting informed decision-making in applications such as active learning and compound screening for drug discovery and materials design.
items.summary_zh: 将保序分位数回归（CQR）与图神经网络结合，用于分子性质预测和校准预测不确定性；在量子力学、物理化学和药代动力学数据集上与多种不确定性方法比较，并在抗生素回顾性虚拟筛选中取得超过 90% 的命中率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为主动学习和药物、材料筛选提供可扩展的不确定性量化框架，重点价值在于覆盖率校准和对异方差噪声的处理。需注意结果主要来自回顾性数据与有限样本覆盖保证，尚不能替代前瞻性实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 准确的预测不确定性量化（pUQ）对于评估化学性质预测至关重要。不正确的量化可能导致对注定失败的候选药物进行代价高昂的合成与表征，或造成误导性的环境监管。本研究将保序分位数回归（CQR）与图神经网络相结合，以实现准确的分子性质预测和校准良好的预测不确定性量化。CQR 将保序预测与分位数回归结合起来，可提供与模型无关、分布无关且在有限样本上具有有效覆盖率的预测区间。我们将其与包括集成、蒙特卡洛 dropout 采样、均值-方差估计和证据回归在内的成熟 pUQ 方法进行基准比较。在涵盖量子力学、物理化学和药代动力学的数据集上，我们的实验表明，CQR 通常能提供较强的校准，同时保持具有竞争力的预测准确度和不确定性排序性能。它还能有效捕捉异方差噪声，这是稳健 pUQ 的关键要求。此外，我们通过一个面向抗生素发现的不确定性引导回顾性虚拟筛选实验展示了其有效性，命中率超过 90%。这些结果表明，CQR 是分子性质预测中一种有前景且可扩展的 pUQ 工具，可支持药物发现和材料设计中的主动学习与化合物筛选等应用的知情决策。
items.author_line: Shih-Cheng Li, Charlles R. A. Abreu, Markus Kraft, William H. Green

items.title: De Novo Design of Enantioselective Artificial Metalloenzyme Photocatalysts Containing Metal Polypyridine Cofactors
items.abstract_or_text: The ability to create protein scaffolds that impart enantioselectivity to simple, readily available metal catalysts could redefine the landscape of asymmetric catalysis. Artificial metalloenzymes (ArMs), hybrid catalysts that combine a synthetic metal cofactor with a protein scaffold, offer a potential means to achieve this goal, but scaffold discovery has remained constrained by trial-and-error approaches and the functional limits of extant proteins. In this study, we show that generative protein design can be harnessed to create de novo scaffolds that selectively accommodate one enantiomer of a metal polypyridine photocatalyst as a cofactor. The resulting ArMs enable efficient, enantioselective photocatalysis, highlighting a broadly applicable route for programming stereocontrol into metalloenzyme catalysts. High total turnover numbers are achieved, the ArMs can be recycled by simply extracting reaction products and reusing the aqueous ArM solution for subsequent reactions, and even commercially available racemic cofactor can be used for ArM formation. Transient Absorption characterization revealed that improvements to catalysis result from the increased quantum yield and excited state lifetime of the cofactor upon binding and substrate binding proximal to the cofactor within the ArM active site, which controls reaction stereoselectivity and the mechanism of energy transfer involved in photocatalysis. The simplicity of this approach could help transition ArM research out of a small group of specialist labs to any capable of expressing synthetic genes and working with commercially available metal complexes.
items.summary_zh: 利用生成式蛋白质设计从头构建人工金属酶支架，使金属多吡啶光催化辅因子实现对映选择性光催化；瞬态吸收表征将催化提升归因于辅因子量子产率和激发态寿命增加以及活性位点近端底物结合。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 展示了将立体控制“编程”进人工金属酶的设计路线，并结合可回收催化和商业外消旋辅因子使用，具有方法学创新。摘要未给出底物范围和长期稳定性边界，推广性仍需更多反应体系验证。
items.abstract_zh: 创造能够赋予简单、易得金属催化剂以对映选择性的蛋白质支架，可能重新定义不对称催化的格局。人工金属酶（ArM）是将合成金属辅因子与蛋白质支架结合的杂化催化剂，为实现这一目标提供了潜在途径，但支架发现一直受限于试错方法和现有蛋白质的功能边界。在本研究中，我们展示了如何利用生成式蛋白质设计，从头构建能够选择性容纳金属多吡啶光催化剂某一对映体作为辅因子的支架。所得 ArM 可实现高效且具有对映选择性的光催化，凸显出一种为金属酶催化剂编程立体控制的普适路线。该 ArM 达到了较高的总周转数；只需萃取反应产物并重复使用水相 ArM 溶液，即可实现循环使用；甚至可以使用市售外消旋辅因子形成 ArM。瞬态吸收表征显示，催化性能的提升源于辅因子结合后量子产率和激发态寿命的增加，以及 ArM 活性位点内靠近辅因子的底物结合；后者控制反应立体选择性和光催化中的能量转移机制。这一路线的简便性有望使 ArM 研究走出少数专业实验室，扩展到任何能够表达合成基因并使用市售金属配合物的实验室。
items.author_line: Sandip Mishra, Payal, Declan Evans, Kingsley Bortey, Husayn Bootwala, Giovanni Gonzalez-Gutierrez, Ricardo Javier Vázquez, David Baker, Jared C Lewis

items.title: Computationally Guided Discovery of Cannabinoid Derivatives for Antiviral and Anticancer Applications: From Chemical Space to Experimental Validation
items.abstract_or_text: Cannabinoids represent a chemically diverse and structurally tunable class of natural and synthetic compounds that have attracted growing interest as molecular scaffolds for therapeutic discovery. However, their extensive chemical diversity, polypharmacology, conformational flexibility, and complex pharmacokinetic properties make the systematic identification and optimisation of therapeutically useful derivatives challenging. Recent advances in computer-aided drug discovery (CADD), molecular simulation, quantum chemistry, quantitative structure–activity relationship (QSAR) modelling, and artificial intelligence (AI) provide opportunities to interrogate the chemical space of cannabinoids in a systematic and mechanistically informed manner. This review examines computational strategies for the discovery and optimisation of cannabinoid derivatives with potential antiviral and anticancer applications, emphasising the integration of complementary computational approaches rather than reliance on isolated in silico predictions. A hierarchical computational workflow is described, progressing from cannabinoid chemical-space generation and ligand preparation to disease-relevant target identification, virtual screening, molecular docking, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, binding free-energy estimation, quantum-chemical analysis, and ADMET/drug-likeness prediction. For antiviral discovery, computational investigations of SARS-CoV-2 targets, including the main protease (Mpro/3CLpro), papain-like protease (PLpro), spike protein, and spike–ACE2 interface, are discussed alongside emerging host-directed targets. For anticancer applications, computational studies involving EGFR, HER2, VEGFR, PI3K/AKT, MAPK, apoptosis, autophagy, oxidative stress, and cell-cycle regulation are evaluated. Particular emphasis is placed on the complementary roles of docking and MD simulations in characterising binding modes, interaction persistence, conformational stability, and molecular recognition, while MM-PBSA/MM-GBSA and related approaches provide additional energetic criteria for candidate prioritisation. QSAR and AI/ML-assisted approaches are further considered as complementary tools for expanding chemical-space exploration, predicting biological activity and ADMET properties, and enabling multi-parameter candidate prioritisation. Importantly, computational affinity scores are not treated as sufficient evidence of target inhibition or therapeutic efficacy. Instead, the review emphasises a progressive validation framework in which computationally prioritised candidates are evaluated through biochemical target-engagement studies, cellular assays, and, where appropriate, in vivo models. Experimental observations can subsequently inform structure–activity relationship analysis, lead optimisation, and iterative computational rescreening, establishing a closed-loop strategy for integrating molecular recognition, dynamic behaviour, binding energetics, pharmacokinetic properties, toxicity, and biological activity during cannabinoid lead development. The review critically examines key limitations of current computational approaches, including incomplete treatment of ligand flexibility, scoring-function limitations, protein conformational heterogeneity, limited experimental validation, dataset bias in AI/ML models, and translational challenges associated with cannabinoid solubility, bioavailability, metabolism, receptor promiscuity, psychoactive liabilities, and off-target effects. Collectively, current evidence indicates that computationally guided cannabinoid discovery is a promising but predominantly preclinical strategy. Further progress will depend on integrating CADD, molecular simulation, AI-assisted molecular design, uncertainty-aware prediction, and experimental validation into iterative multi-objective optimisation frameworks that jointly address potency, selectivity, pharmacokinetics, toxicity, and translational relevance.
items.summary_zh: 综述以大麻素衍生物为对象的计算药物发现流程，整合化学空间生成、靶点识别、虚拟筛选、分子对接、分子动力学、自由能、量子化学、QSAR、AI/ML 和 ADMET，并强调生化、细胞及动物验证的闭环。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 系统梳理了抗病毒和抗癌大麻素发现中多种计算层级的互补关系，并明确指出亲和力评分不能等同于靶点抑制或治疗效果。它是方法路线综述而非新实验研究，且作者强调证据总体仍处于临床前阶段。
items.abstract_zh: 大麻素是化学多样且结构可调的一类天然和合成化合物，作为治疗发现的分子骨架日益受到关注。然而，其广泛的化学多样性、多重药理作用、构象柔性和复杂的药代动力学性质，使系统识别和优化具有治疗价值的衍生物面临挑战。计算机辅助药物发现（CADD）、分子模拟、量子化学、定量构效关系（QSAR）建模和人工智能（AI）的最新进展，为以系统且具有机制依据的方式研究大麻素化学空间提供了机会。本综述考察了用于发现和优化具有潜在抗病毒与抗癌应用的大麻素衍生物的计算策略，强调整合互补的计算方法，而不是依赖孤立的计算预测。文中描述了一个分层计算流程，从大麻素化学空间生成和配体准备开始，依次进行疾病相关靶点识别、虚拟筛选、分子对接、分子动力学（MD）模拟、结合自由能估计、量子化学分析以及 ADMET/类药性预测。对于抗病毒发现，综述讨论了针对 SARS-CoV-2 靶点的计算研究，包括主蛋白酶（Mpro/3CLpro）、木瓜样蛋白酶（PLpro）、刺突蛋白和 spike-ACE2 界面，以及新兴的宿主导向靶点。对于抗癌应用，综述评估了涉及 EGFR、HER2、VEGFR、PI3K/AKT、MAPK、凋亡、自噬、氧化应激和细胞周期调控的计算研究。文章特别强调对接和 MD 模拟在表征结合模式、相互作用持续性、构象稳定性和分子识别方面的互补作用，同时 MM-PBSA/MM-GBSA 及相关方法提供额外的能量学标准以进行候选物优先级排序。QSAR 和 AI/ML 辅助方法还被视为扩展化学空间探索、预测生物活性与 ADMET 性质以及实现多参数候选物排序的互补工具。重要的是，计算亲和力评分并不被视为靶点抑制或治疗效果的充分证据。相反，综述强调一种渐进式验证框架：通过生化靶点结合研究、细胞实验以及在适当情况下的体内模型，对计算优先筛选出的候选物进行评估。实验观察随后可以用于构效关系分析、先导优化和迭代式计算再筛选，从而建立一个闭环策略，在大麻素先导开发过程中整合分子识别、动态行为、结合能、药代动力学性质、毒性和生物活性。综述批判性地分析了当前计算方法的关键局限，包括对配体柔性的处理不完整、评分函数局限、蛋白质构象异质性、实验验证有限、AI/ML 模型中的数据集偏差，以及与大麻素溶解度、生物利用度、代谢、受体多重作用、精神活性风险和脱靶效应相关的转化挑战。总体而言，现有证据表明，计算引导的大麻素发现是一种有前景但主要处于临床前阶段的策略。进一步进展将取决于把 CADD、分子模拟、AI 辅助分子设计、具备不确定性感知能力的预测和实验验证整合进迭代式多目标优化框架，并同时处理效力、选择性、药代动力学、毒性和转化相关性。
items.author_line: VIVEK KUMAR YADAV

items.title: Gas-Conditioned Message Passing Graph Neural Network for Permeability Prediction in Polymeric Membranes
items.abstract_or_text: Designing polymeric membranes for diverse gas-separation applications remains a critical challenge. Machine learning (ML) models can significantly accelerate this effort by capturing complex relationships between polymer-gas pairs and enabling permeability prediction over an extended chemical space of gases and polymers. In this work, we present a novel ML framework, the gas-conditioned message passing neural network (GC-MPNN), that jointly combines gas descriptors and polymer chemistry in a fused neural network model. Polymers are represented at the monomer level and encoded as molecular graphs, where node and edge information is propagated through message-passing layers. Six gas species (He, H2, N2, O2, CH4, and CO2) are represented using multiple descriptor sets spanning thermodynamic, kinetic, and electrostatic properties, along with one-hot encodings and combined feature sets that include kinetic plus thermodynamic descriptors and the full physicochemical descriptor set. For each descriptor combination, model hyperparameters are optimized using Bayesian optimization within a leave-one-gas-out (LOGO) validation framework. Test performance is then evaluated on the gas species excluded entirely from the corresponding training fold (out-of-training set) and compared across descriptor sets. For most gas species, the model achieves strong predictive performance (R2 ∼ 0.86–0.96), while CO2 remains more challenging in terms of absolute prediction accuracy (R2 ∼ 0.44). Active learning sampling further improves model performance by adding a few labeled samples from the test gas species into the training set. Among the three strategies tested, deep ensemble-based sampling and random sampling show strong improvement, with R2 reaching approximately ∼ 0.95 for all gas species, while evidential regression shows less consistent improvement. The model is further evaluated on a smaller polymer-gas dataset containing hydrocarbon species (C2H4, C2H6, C3H6, C3H8, and n-C4H10) using the GC-MPNN trained only on the six base gases, achieving moderate to strong Pearson correlations (r ∼ 0.77–0.89) for these out-of-training gases. Overall, this work presents a machine learning model that can learn transferable polymer-gas relationships from known gas species and extend them to previously unseen gases.
items.summary_zh: 提出气体条件化消息传递图神经网络（GC-MPNN），将气体描述符与聚合物分子图融合，用留一气体验证评估对未见气体的渗透率预测，并结合主动学习改善性能。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为聚合物膜设计提供了跨气体迁移的建模框架，且显式测试了 out-of-training 泛化。需要留意 CO2 预测明显较弱，主动学习加入测试气体标签后性能提升也会改变纯外推设定。
items.abstract_zh: 针对多样化气体分离应用设计聚合物膜仍是一项关键挑战。机器学习（ML）模型能够捕捉聚合物-气体对之间的复杂关系，并在更大的气体和聚合物化学空间中实现渗透率预测，从而显著加速这一过程。在本研究中，我们提出一种新的 ML 框架，即气体条件化消息传递神经网络（GC-MPNN），将气体描述符与聚合物化学共同融合到一个神经网络模型中。聚合物在单体层面表示，并编码为分子图，节点和边的信息通过消息传递层传播。六种气体（He、H2、N2、O2、CH4 和 CO2）使用多组描述符表示，描述符覆盖热力学、动力学和静电性质，还包括 one-hot 编码，以及包含动力学加热力学描述符和完整物理化学描述符的组合特征。对于每种描述符组合，模型超参数都在留一气体（LOGO）验证框架中通过贝叶斯优化进行优化。随后，在相应训练折中完全排除的气体种类上评估测试性能（训练外集合），并比较不同描述符集合的表现。对于大多数气体，该模型取得较强的预测性能（R2 约为 0.86–0.96），而 CO2 在绝对预测准确度方面更具挑战性（R2 约为 0.44）。主动学习采样通过向训练集加入少量来自测试气体种类的标注样本，进一步提升模型性能。在测试的三种策略中，基于深度集成的采样和随机采样均表现出明显改进，对所有气体的 R2 达到约 0.95，而证据回归的改进一致性较低。我们还在一个较小的聚合物-气体数据集上进一步评估模型，该数据集包含烃类气体（C2H4、C2H6、C3H6、C3H8 和 n-C4H10）；使用仅在六种基础气体上训练的 GC-MPNN，对这些训练外气体取得中等到较强的 Pearson 相关性（r 约为 0.77–0.89）。总体而言，该工作提出的机器学习模型能够从已知气体种类中学习可迁移的聚合物-气体关系，并将其扩展到此前未见过的气体。

items.title: Fully Automated System for Exploring Molecular Dynamics Trajectories
items.abstract_or_text: Molecular dynamics (MD) studies often require separate tools for system preparation, simulation, enhanced sampling, analysis, and reporting, creating opportunities for inconsistent settings and undocumented decisions. We present FastMDXplora, an open-source Python framework built on OpenMM that integrates setup, simulation, analysis, and report phases through a single declarative configuration. A shared schema supports command-line and browser-based graphical interfaces. An optional artificial intelligence (AI) agent generates study configurations from natural-language descriptions, subject to the same validation as user-defined configurations. Each phase records its resolved settings, software versions, and execution environment. When a requested result lacks sufficient support, the software withholds it and reports the reason through a registry of 111 typed refusal codes. Fifteen estimator tests recover analytical benchmarks, including statistical inefficiencies within 2 % of reference values and WHAM reconstruction of analytical free-energy profiles from synthetic umbrella-sampling data with root-mean-square errors below 0.1 kJ mol−1. A labeled corpus of 25 defective and 26 clean studies produces the expected outcomes in all 51 cases. Calibration against ten replicas shows that singlerun standard errors at 20 ns can be up to tenfold smaller than replica-based estimates, even when the estimated correlation time is resolved. The software withholds standard errors when its correlation diagnostics fail, but passing these diagnostics does not establish calibrated uncertainty. In a trypsin–benzamidine case study, interaction analysis reveals differences in the engagement of Asp189 between two ligand charge states that are not distinguished by total contact counts. FastMDXplora provides an integrated framework for reproducible MD studies, combining workflow automation with explicit validation and provenance while preserving the need for independent assessment of sampling and uncertainty. The source code is available at https://github.com/aai-research-lab/FastMDXplora.
items.summary_zh: 发布开源 Python 框架 FastMDXplora，以统一声明式配置整合 OpenMM 分子动力学的准备、模拟、分析和报告，并记录版本、环境及拒答原因；分析基准、缺陷研究语料和 trypsin-benzamidine 案例验证了流程能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把可复现性、来源追踪和显式拒答机制纳入 MD 自动化，适合标准化复杂工作流。摘要同时显示单次运行标准误可能远小于重复模拟估计，且诊断通过并不等于不确定性已校准。
items.abstract_zh: 分子动力学（MD）研究通常需要分别使用系统准备、模拟、增强采样、分析和报告工具，这为设置不一致和决策未记录留下了空间。我们提出 FastMDXplora，这是一个基于 OpenMM 构建的开源 Python 框架，通过单一声明式配置整合设置、模拟、分析和报告阶段。共享模式同时支持命令行和基于浏览器的图形界面。一个可选的人工智能（AI）代理可以根据自然语言描述生成研究配置，并接受与用户定义配置相同的验证。每个阶段都会记录解析后的设置、软件版本和执行环境。当请求的结果缺乏足够支持时，软件会暂不提供该结果，并通过包含 111 个类型化拒答代码的注册表报告原因。15 项估计器测试重现了分析基准，包括统计低效性与参考值的偏差在 2% 以内，以及使用合成伞形采样数据重构 WHAM 分析自由能曲线，均方根误差低于 0.1 kJ mol−1。一个包含 25 个缺陷研究和 26 个合格研究的标注语料库在全部 51 个案例中都得到预期结果。与十个重复模拟的校准比较显示，即使估计的相关时间已被解析，20 ns 时单次运行的标准误也可能比基于重复模拟的估计小十倍。软件在相关性诊断失败时会暂不提供标准误，但通过这些诊断并不能证明不确定性已经校准。在 trypsin-benzamidine 案例研究中，相互作用分析揭示了两种配体电荷状态对 Asp189 参与方式的差异，而总接触数无法区分这种差异。FastMDXplora 提供了一个可复现 MD 研究的集成框架，将工作流自动化与显式验证和来源追踪结合起来，同时保留对采样和不确定性进行独立评估的必要性。源代码可在 https://github.com/aai-research-lab/FastMDXplora 获取。
items.author_line: Adekunle Aina, Derrick Kwan, Oliche Brown, Obinna Otegbulu, Victory Unegbu, Ayush Kumar

items.title: Development of a nanomedicine approach to improve the therapeutic index of bexarotene.
items.abstract_or_text: Bexarotene (BEX), a retinoid X receptor (RXR) agonist, has demonstrated therapeutic potential in oncology, neurodegenerative diseases and inflammatory conditions, including multiple sclerosis (MS). However, its broader clinical application is limited by poor aqueous solubility, low bioavailability, and dose-limiting adverse effects, most notably hypertriglyceridaemia. In this study, we investigated whether conjugation of BEX to dextrin, a biodegradable polysaccharide, could improve its physicochemical properties and therapeutic index. A dextrin-BEX conjugate was synthesised using succinoylated dextrin (30 mol%) and characterised by gel permeation chromatography (GPC), Fourier-transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy, nuclear magnetic resonance (1H-NMR) and dynamic light scattering (DLS). The effects of conjugation on solubility, aggregation behaviour and biological activity were evaluated using in vitro cytotoxicity assays in leukaemia, liver and fibroblast cell lines, alongside measurements of intracellular triglyceride levels. The impact on lipid metabolism and toxicity was further assessed in an in vivo murine model of hyperlipidaemia. Dextrin conjugation significantly increased the aqueous solubility of BEX (from <0.004 mg/mL to 9.88 mg/mL) and led to the formation of nanoscale aggregates in solution. This was associated with a marked increase in in vitro potency, with IC50 values reduced by up to 14-fold across multiple cell lines. However, the increased cytotoxicity was not selective for cancer cells and was also observed in normal fibroblast and hepatic cell models. The dextrin-BEX conjugate did not induce intracellular triglyceride accumulation in vitro. In vivo, dextrin conjugation did not mitigate BEX-associated lipid dysregulation, while serum triglyceride levels and markers of liver injury remained unchanged. However, although free BEX led to a significant increase in liver weight after 14 days, the dextrin-BEX conjugate did not produce a statistically significant effect. In conclusion, dextrin conjugation markedly improves the solubility and in vitro potency of BEX but does not enhance its selectivity or reduce its metabolic toxicity in vivo. These findings suggest that while polymer conjugation is an effective strategy for addressing physicochemical limitations, it is insufficient to overcome the inherent dyslipidaemia associated with systemic RXR activation. Future strategies should focus on integrating targeting and controlled release mechanisms, alongside approaches that address the underlying pharmacological drivers of lipid dysregulation.
items.summary_zh: 将 bexarotene（BEX）与可降解多糖 dextrin 偶联，显著提高水溶性并增强体外效力；但未改善癌细胞选择性或体内脂质代谢毒性，仅在肝重增加方面显示较温和影响。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同时展示了纳米化偶联改善物化性质的效果及其转化局限：溶解度和体外 IC50 改善并未解决 RXR 激动导致的全身性血脂异常。体内疗效与安全性仍不足以支持直接临床外推。
items.abstract_zh: Bexarotene（BEX）是一种 retinoid X receptor（RXR）激动剂，已显示出在肿瘤学、神经退行性疾病和炎症性疾病（包括多发性硬化症（MS））中的治疗潜力。然而，其更广泛的临床应用受到水溶性差、生物利用度低以及剂量限制性不良反应的限制，其中最显著的是高甘油三酯血症。在本研究中，我们考察了将 BEX 与 dextrin（一种可生物降解的多糖）偶联是否能够改善其物理化学性质和治疗指数。研究人员使用 succinoylated dextrin（30 mol%）合成 dextrin-BEX 偶联物，并通过凝胶渗透色谱（GPC）、傅里叶变换红外（FTIR）光谱、核磁共振（1H-NMR）和动态光散射（DLS）进行表征。偶联对溶解度、聚集行为和生物活性的影响通过体外细胞毒性实验进行评估，所用细胞系包括白血病、肝脏和成纤维细胞系，同时测量细胞内甘油三酯水平。研究还在高脂血症小鼠体内模型中进一步评估了其对脂质代谢和毒性的影响。Dextrin 偶联使 BEX 的水溶性显著提高（从 <0.004 mg/mL 增至 9.88 mg/mL），并导致溶液中形成纳米尺度聚集体。这与体外效力显著增强相关，在多种细胞系中 IC50 值最多降低 14 倍。然而，细胞毒性增强并不具有癌细胞选择性，在正常成纤维细胞和肝细胞模型中也观察到这种现象。体外实验中，dextrin-BEX 偶联物未诱导细胞内甘油三酯蓄积。在体内，dextrin 偶联并未缓解 BEX 相关的脂质失调，血清甘油三酯水平和肝损伤标志物也未发生变化。不过，游离 BEX 在 14 天后导致肝重显著增加，而 dextrin-BEX 偶联物未产生统计学显著影响。总之，dextrin 偶联显著改善了 BEX 的溶解度和体外效力，但没有提高其选择性，也没有降低其体内代谢毒性。这些发现表明，聚合物偶联是解决物理化学限制的有效策略，但不足以克服全身性 RXR 激活所固有的血脂异常。未来策略应聚焦于整合靶向和控释机制，同时采用能够应对脂质失调潜在药理驱动因素的方法。

items.title: CLARA: Compound Library Active Learning with Reasoning Agents
items.abstract_or_text: Batch active learning for ligand discovery requires a recurring decision about whether to exploit high predicted affinity, reduce model uncertainty, or broaden chemical coverage. We test whether a language model can make this strategy-level decision while candidate ranking and label revelation remain controlled by a deterministic Gaussian-process environment. Across four protein targets, ten paired seeds, and a 360-compound assay budget, a GPT-5.6 Sol agent outperformed random sampling in all 40 matched campaigns. Its final top-2\% recall was 0.412 on D2R, 0.374 on Mpro, 0.448 on TYK2, and 0.683 on USP7. It was statistically tied with the strongest fixed policy on Mpro and USP7 but underperformed target-specific leaders on D2R and TYK2. The agent shifted from exploration-oriented early batches toward exploitation and produced 686 testable threshold claims with an 86.3\% atomic success rate, although 19.8\% of forecasts were not numerically scorable. In 200 prespecified information-ablation campaigns, removing uncertainty, diversity, or memory caused only small endpoint changes, while shuffling explanatory evidence reproduced the full allocation path in 39 of 40 paired campaigns. A deterministic 80\% availability constraint reduced recall on every target but preserved the target-dependent pattern of wins and losses. These results support language-model strategy control as a feasible and auditable layer.
items.summary_zh: CLARA 让 GPT-5.6 Sol 在由确定性 Gaussian-process 环境控制候选排序和标签揭示的批量主动学习中决定探索与利用策略；在四个靶点的 40 个匹配活动中优于随机采样，但不稳定胜过目标特异固定策略。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把语言模型限制在可审计的策略控制层，并用信息消融和证据打乱检验其决策依赖，提供了较清晰的评估范式。结果仍来自确定性模拟环境，且 19.8% 预测不可数值评分，实际实验收益尚待验证。
items.abstract_zh: 配体发现中的批量主动学习需要反复决定是利用高预测亲和力、降低模型不确定性，还是扩大化学覆盖范围。我们测试语言模型能否在候选排序和标签揭示均由确定性 Gaussian-process 环境控制的情况下，作出这一策略层面的决策。在四个蛋白质靶点、十组配对种子和 360 个化合物的实验预算下，GPT-5.6 Sol 在全部 40 个匹配活动中都优于随机采样。其最终前 2% 召回率在 D2R、Mpro、TYK2 和 USP7 上分别为 0.412、0.374、0.448 和 0.683。在 Mpro 和 USP7 上，它与最强的固定策略在统计上相当，但在 D2R 和 TYK2 上不如针对靶点的领先策略。该代理从早期批次的探索导向转向利用导向，并生成了 686 条可测试的阈值声明，原子成功率为 86.3%；不过，19.8% 的预测无法进行数值评分。在预先规定的 200 个信息消融活动中，移除不确定性、多样性或记忆只导致终点发生小幅变化，而打乱解释性证据在 40 个配对活动中的 39 个中重现了完整的分配路径。确定性的 80% 可用性约束降低了每个靶点的召回率，但保留了胜负随靶点变化的模式。这些结果支持把语言模型的策略控制作为一个可行且可审计的层。
items.author_line: Srivastava, S. P., Saxena, V., Singh, D., Singh, H., Singh, R. K.

items.title: Text-mined dataset of sol-gel synthesis protocols with phase purity outcomes using large language models
items.abstract_or_text: Sol-gel synthesis is a versatile method for producing inorganic materials that offers advantages such as atomic-level mixing and lower processing temperatures over traditional solid-state methods. Despite these benefits, achieving phase purity remains a challenge due to the process's sensitivity to synthesis parameters such as precursor choice, solvent selection, and heating conditions. Negative results, such as phase-impure outcomes, are essential for understanding sol-gel reaction pathways, but are largely absent from existing curated datasets. This work leverages Gemini 3.0 Flash to construct a text-mined inorganic sol-gel database with phase purity information. The dataset contains ~148,000 synthesis records, including ~28,000 phase-impure entries. All extracted entities achieved F1 scores greater than 0.89. At the record level, 68% of extracted records match human annotation on all evaluated fields. Furthermore, to validate the scientific utility of our dataset, we demonstrate that the aggregated data reproduces previously reported phase-purity trends for BiFeO 3 thin films.
items.summary_zh: 使用 Gemini 3.0 Flash 从文献中抽取溶胶-凝胶合成记录及相纯度结果，构建约 148,000 条记录、包含约 28,000 条相不纯结果的数据集；实体抽取 F1 均高于 0.89，并复现 BiFeO3 薄膜相纯度趋势。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把大量负结果纳入无机材料合成数据库，能支持相纯度规律挖掘和数据驱动工艺设计。需注意 68% 的记录在全部字段上与人工标注一致，文本抽取误差仍可能影响下游结论。
items.abstract_zh: 溶胶-凝胶合成是制备无机材料的一种多用途方法，相比传统固相法具有原子级混合和更低加工温度等优势。尽管如此，由于该过程对前驱体选择、溶剂选择和加热条件等合成参数十分敏感，实现相纯度仍然具有挑战性。负结果（例如相不纯的结果）对于理解溶胶-凝胶反应路径至关重要，但在现有整理好的数据集中大多缺失。本研究利用 Gemini 3.0 Flash 构建了一个包含相纯度信息、通过文本挖掘得到的无机溶胶-凝胶数据库。该数据集包含约 148,000 条合成记录，其中包括约 28,000 条相不纯记录。所有抽取实体的 F1 分数均高于 0.89。在记录层面，68% 的抽取记录在所有评估字段上都与人工标注匹配。此外，为验证该数据集的科学效用，我们展示了聚合数据能够重现此前报道的 BiFeO3 薄膜相纯度趋势。
items.author_line: Wesley Y. Chen, Sanghoon Lee, Tim Kodalle, Philothei Sahinidis, Gerbrand Ceder, Carolin M. Sutter-Fella, Anubhav Jain

items.title: Cross-flow microfluidic photocatalysis with metal-organic framework thin films
items.abstract_or_text: Metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) offer tunable reaction space, and using them as porous photocatalysts also allows the catalyst to be recovered and reused. In practice, though, performance is often constrained by how quickly reactants diffuse through the porous material and how well light reaches the active sites. In this work, we present an approach that pairs a MOF thin-film photocatalyst with a cross-flow microfluidic reactor. The thin film sets a well-defined diffusion length, the transparent thin film let light reach the active layer, and crossflow microfluidics allow diffusion control. Together, these features give control over reactant transport and improve illumination of the photocatalyst. To build the photocatalyst, we noncovalently load Ru(bpy)3(PF6)2 (bpy = 2,2′-bipyridine) into mesopores created by defects in a hierarchically porous Zr-based UiO-66 thin film. The well-established aerobic oxidation of ethyl 2-bromo-2-phenylacetate to ethyl 2-oxo-2-phenylacetate serves as a benchmark reaction; it is a test case rather than the main finding of the study. Under cross-flow conditions, the photocatalyst reaches a turnover frequency about ten times that of the equivalent MOF powder system, and it also outperforms the homogeneous benchmark. These findings highlight cross-flow microfluidics as a promising strategy for managing both mass transport and light delivery in MOF-based photocatalysis.
items.summary_zh: 将 MOF 薄膜光催化剂与横流微流控反应器结合，以缩短扩散距离并改善光照；在缺陷多孔 Zr 基 UiO-66 薄膜中负载 Ru(bpy)3(PF6)2 后，基准氧化反应的 turnover frequency 约为 MOF 粉末体系的 10 倍。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同时处理多孔催化中的传质与光传递瓶颈，说明微流控几何结构可成为 MOF 光催化工程化放大的设计变量。摘要只报告单一基准反应，不能据此推断对更广泛反应的普适提升。
items.abstract_zh: 金属-有机框架（MOF）具有可调控的反应空间，将其用作多孔光催化剂还能够实现催化剂回收和重复使用。然而，在实践中，性能往往受限于反应物通过多孔材料扩散的速度，以及光线到达活性位点的程度。在本研究中，我们提出一种将 MOF 薄膜光催化剂与横流微流控反应器结合的方法。薄膜设定了明确的扩散长度，透明薄膜使光线能够到达活性层，而横流微流控则允许控制扩散。这些特征共同实现了对反应物传输的控制，并改善了光催化剂的照明。为构建光催化剂，我们将 Ru(bpy)3(PF6)2（bpy = 2,2′-bipyridine）以非共价方式负载到具有层级孔结构的 Zr 基 UiO-66 薄膜中由缺陷形成的介孔内。广为建立的 2-bromo-2-phenylacetate 乙酯好氧氧化为 2-oxo-2-phenylacetate 乙酯反应被用作基准反应；它是一个测试案例，而不是本研究的主要发现。在横流条件下，光催化剂的 turnover frequency 约为等效 MOF 粉末体系的 10 倍，并且也优于均相基准体系。这些发现表明，横流微流控是管理 MOF 光催化中传质和光传递的一种有前景的策略。
items.author_line: Suvendu Panda, Bijan Sarkar, Rajarshi Ghosh, Pradipta Saha, Riju Paria, Ravichandran Shivanna, Ritesh Haldar

items.title: CAN it work? Using hydroxyethyl acrylate or methacrylate to turn epoxy-amine thermosets into covalent adaptable network materials.
items.abstract_or_text: Epoxy-amine thermosets can be converted into covalent adaptable networks (CANs) by adding β-aminoester-based curing agents to the formulation. This is achieved by utilizing commercially available di- or trifunctional acrylate monomers, which react with the amine component via an aza-Michael addition. Consequently, this approach is inherently scalable and holds high industrial relevance. In this study, the fundamental applicability of two commodity chemicals—namely 2-hydroxyethyl acrylate (HEA) and 2-hydroxyethyl methacrylate (HEMA)—for this purpose is investigated, aiming to provide an additional handle to mitigate the rapid viscosity increase of the formulations. Using a model epoxy resin consisting of bisphenol A diglycidyl ether (DGEBA) and 1,3-bis(aminomethyl)cyclohexane (BAC), it was demonstrated that a Lewis-base catalyst (1-methylimidazole) is necessary to incorporate the hydroxy groups of HEA and HEMA into the network. Contrary to expectations, this incorporation proceeds predominantly through a condensation reaction that liberates ethylene glycol. Finally, a formulation consisting of 1 equiv. DGEBA, 0.5 equiv. BAC, 1 equiv. HEA, and 0.025 equiv. 1-methylimidazole was found to offer a good compromise, providing both satisfactory reprocessability and a sufficiently high glass transition temperature (74 °C). Compared to a reference formulation made with a trifunctional acrylate monomer, the CAN made with HEA is characterized by a lower glass transition temperature, a similar flow activation energy, a lower storage modulus, and distinctly longer relaxation times. Both acrylate-based CAN materials aged under thermal stress, which resulted in higher storage moduli and glass transition temperatures upon reprocessing. A protocol for characterizing such modulus changes under thermal stress is suggested, consisting of performing repeated frequency sweeps for at least 1 h at temperatures slightly exceeding the maximum temperature of the stress relaxation measurements.
items.summary_zh: 研究用 2-hydroxyethyl acrylate（HEA）或 2-hydroxyethyl methacrylate（HEMA）把环氧-胺热固性材料转化为共价适应性网络（CAN）；在 DGEBA/BAC 模型体系中，HEA 配方兼顾了可再加工性与 74 °C 玻璃化转变温度。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提供使用商品化单体和可放大工艺制备 CAN 的路线，并揭示羟基引入主要通过缩合而非预期的 aza-Michael 加成。材料性能会随热老化改变，长期循环稳定性仍需关注。
items.abstract_zh: 通过向配方中加入基于 β-氨基酯的固化剂，可以将环氧-胺热固性材料转化为共价适应性网络（CAN）。实现这一点的方法是利用商业上可得的二官能或三官能丙烯酸酯单体，使其与胺组分发生 aza-Michael 加成。因此，该方法具有内在的可放大性和较高的工业相关性。在本研究中，我们考察了两种大宗化学品——2-hydroxyethyl acrylate（HEA）和 2-hydroxyethyl methacrylate（HEMA）——在这一用途中的基本适用性，目标是提供另一种缓解配方黏度快速升高的手段。使用由 bisphenol A diglycidyl ether（DGEBA）和 1,3-bis(aminomethyl)cyclohexane（BAC）组成的模型环氧树脂体系，研究表明需要 Lewis 碱催化剂（1-methylimidazole）才能将 HEA 和 HEMA 的羟基引入网络。与预期相反，这一引入主要通过释放 ethylene glycol 的缩合反应进行。最终，含 1 equiv. DGEBA、0.5 equiv. BAC、1 equiv. HEA 和 0.025 equiv. 1-methylimidazole 的配方被发现能够提供较好的折中，同时实现满意的可再加工性和足够高的玻璃化转变温度（74 °C）。与使用三官能丙烯酸酯单体制备的参考配方相比，HEA 制得的 CAN 具有更低的玻璃化转变温度、相近的流动活化能、更低的储能模量以及明显更长的松弛时间。两种基于丙烯酸酯的 CAN 材料在热应力下老化后，再加工时储能模量和玻璃化转变温度均升高。研究提出了一种表征热应力下此类模量变化的方案：在略高于应力松弛测量最高温度的温度下，连续进行至少 1 h 的重复频率扫描。
items.author_line: Johanna Lang, Christian Slugovc

items.title: Reaction-Level Machine Learning for Condition Optimization in Suzuki–Miyaura Cross-Coupling
items.abstract_or_text: Selecting the ligand, base and solvent for a Suzuki–Miyaura coupling remains largely empirical, and highthroughput experimentation (HTE) screens are usually mined only for one reaction’s best condition. This study tests whether condition–yield relationships learned from some reactions transfer to reactions a model has never seen. Using a published HTE dataset of 5,760 reactions (15 quinoline couplings × 384 ligandbase–solvent combinations), models were trained in MATLAB on categorical condition descriptors with whole reactions held out: a global strategy trained on 12 reactions and was tested on 3; a focused strategy trained on 3 reactions sharing a boronic acid and was tested on a fourth. Selected models were compared with a majority-class predictor and a no-learning condition-average ranker, with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. Ranking transferred: high-yield (≥62%) precision–recall AUC was 0.21–0.34 where only 6–8% of conditions were high-yield and 0.92–0.96 where most were, above the base rate on every held-out reaction. However, the condition-average ranker matched the trained models within overlapping confidence intervals on all four held-out reactions, so what transfers is mainly the persistence of good-on-average conditions. At a fixed 62% cut-off, a RUSBoosted ensemble flagged 58–96% of high-yield conditions against 6–27% for the untuned average. Accuracy misled: naive Bayes scored 94.8% where always predicting low yield scores 94.3%. Exact yields did not transfer (external R2 at or below zero on most reactions), and focusing the training set left ranking unchanged (PR-AUC 0.943 vs 0.942). Reaction-level splits, minority-class metrics and a condition-average baseline should be standard when evaluating models on HTE data.
items.summary_zh: 在 5,760 条 Suzuki-Miyaura 偶联高通量反应数据上进行反应级条件机器学习；反应留出测试显示主要可迁移的是平均意义上的优良条件，而不是精确产率，强调应采用反应级划分、少数类指标和条件平均基线。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 对“条件优化模型能否跨反应迁移”给出克制结论，揭示高准确率可能被类别不平衡掩盖。该研究的价值在于评估规范和负面结果，精确产率外推能力仍然有限。
items.abstract_zh: 为 Suzuki-Miyaura 偶联选择配体、碱和溶剂在很大程度上仍依赖经验，而高通量实验（HTE）筛选通常只被用于挖掘某一个反应的最佳条件。本研究测试了从部分反应中学习到的条件-产率关系，能否迁移到模型从未见过的反应。研究使用一个已发表的 HTE 数据集，其中包含 5,760 个反应（15 个 quinoline 偶联 × 384 个 ligand-base-solvent 组合）；模型在 MATLAB 中基于分类条件描述符训练，并按完整反应留出测试：全局策略用 12 个反应训练、用 3 个反应测试；聚焦策略则使用共享同一 boronic acid 的 3 个反应训练，并在第 4 个反应上测试。研究将选出的模型与多数类预测器和不学习的条件平均排序器进行比较，并报告 95% bootstrap 置信区间。排序能力可以迁移：在只有 6–8% 条件属于高产率条件时，高产率（≥62%）的 precision-recall AUC 为 0.21–0.34；在大多数条件都属于高产率时，该值为 0.92–0.96，并且在每个留出反应上都高于基准率。然而，条件平均排序器在全部四个留出反应上都与训练模型相当，置信区间相互重叠，因此可迁移的主要是“平均而言表现良好的条件”这一持久性。在固定 62% 截止值下，RUSBoosted 集成标出了 58–96% 的高产率条件，而未调优的平均值方法只能标出 6–27%。准确率具有误导性：朴素 Bayes 的准确率为 94.8%，而始终预测低产率的模型也能达到 94.3%。精确产率无法迁移（在大多数反应上外部 R2 小于或等于 0），而聚焦训练集并未改变排序结果（PR-AUC 为 0.943 对 0.942）。在评估 HTE 数据上的模型时，应将反应级划分、少数类指标和条件平均基线作为标准。

items.title: AutoSolvate 2.0: Automated Preparation of Chemically Diverse Explicit-Solvent Systems for Multiscale Molecular Simulation
items.abstract_or_text: Advanced quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM), machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs), and hybrid methods provide powerful engines for modeling solution-phase chemistry. Yet before production begins, chemically diverse explicit-solvent systems must be parameterized, assembled at the desired composition, relaxed, equilibrated, and sampled. This preparatory “first mile” remains labor-intensive, requiring multiple software packages and manual customization, particularly for transition-metal complexes, solvent mixtures, and multicomponent electrolytes. Here, we present AutoSolvate 2.0, a modular, open-source framework that converts molecular structures and solution compositions into equilibrated, simulation-ready explicit-solvent ensembles. The new AutoMCPB module automates Metal Center Parameter Builder (MCPB.py)-based parameterization of transition-metal complexes (TMCs), while generalized system representations support multiple solutes and solvents at arbitrary molar, weight, or volume ratios. Standardized wrappers integrate force-field generation, box construction, minimization, heating, equilibration, classical sampling, and microsolvated-cluster extraction. Native classical molecular dynamics (MD) and TeraChem-based QM/MM workflows execute directly; equilibrated coordinates, velocities, trajectories, and clusters provide starting points for external quantum mechanical (QM), other QM/MM, MLIP training, and hybrid machine learning (ML)/classical workflows. JSON, guided command-line, and Model Context Protocol interfaces support high-throughput and agent-assisted use. We demonstrate these capabilities by reproducing the solvent-dependent absorption spectrum of an aqueous transition-metal photosensitizer, the composition-dependent microsolvation of water–acetonitrile mixtures, and characteristic ion-pairing features of a published multicomponent electrolyte simulation. Together, these applications establish AutoSolvate 2.0 as a preparation and initial-sampling layer connecting chemical system specification to classical, quantum, and machine-learning simulations. Rather than competing with higher-accuracy methods, AutoSolvate provides the on-ramp needed to apply them efficiently to complex explicit-solvent systems.
items.summary_zh: 推出 AutoSolvate 2.0，用模块化开源流程把分子结构和溶液组成转换为平衡的显式溶剂体系；新增过渡金属配合物参数化、多溶质多溶剂比例和 QM/MM、MLIP 接口，并以三个体系复现实例验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 解决复杂显式溶剂模拟准备阶段的高人工成本，为经典 MD、QM/MM 和机器学习势能提供统一入口。它主要解决参数化与初始采样，不等同于更高模拟精度，结果仍取决于下游方法。
items.abstract_zh: 先进的量子力学/分子力学（QM/MM）、机器学习原子间势（MLIP）和混合方法为模拟溶液相化学提供了强大引擎。然而，在开始生产模拟之前，具有化学多样性的显式溶剂体系必须完成参数化、按目标组成组装、弛豫、平衡和采样。这个准备阶段仍然劳动密集，需要多个软件包和人工定制，尤其是对于过渡金属配合物、混合溶剂和多组分电解质。本文提出 AutoSolvate 2.0，这是一个模块化开源框架，可将分子结构和溶液组成转换为达到平衡、可直接用于模拟的显式溶剂系综。新增的 AutoMCPB 模块能够自动完成基于 Metal Center Parameter Builder（MCPB.py）的过渡金属配合物（TMC）参数化，而通用系统表示支持多个溶质和多个溶剂，并允许任意摩尔比、质量比或体积比。标准化包装器整合了力场生成、盒子构建、最小化、升温、平衡、经典采样和微溶剂化团簇提取。原生经典分子动力学（MD）和基于 TeraChem 的 QM/MM 工作流可以直接执行；平衡后的坐标、速度、轨迹和团簇可为外部量子力学（QM）、其他 QM/MM、MLIP 训练以及混合机器学习（ML）/经典工作流提供起点。JSON、引导式命令行和 Model Context Protocol 接口支持高通量及代理辅助使用。我们通过三个应用展示这些能力：重现水相过渡金属光敏剂的溶剂依赖吸收光谱、重现 water-acetonitrile 混合物中随组成变化的微溶剂化，以及重现已发表多组分电解质模拟中的特征离子对缔合。总体而言，这些应用确立了 AutoSolvate 2.0 作为准备和初始采样层的作用，将化学体系指定连接到经典、量子和机器学习模拟。AutoSolvate 并不与更高精度的方法竞争，而是提供了高效应用这些方法所需的入口。
items.author_line: Sangni Xun, Fangning Ren, Pinyuan Li, Xu Chen, Lechen Dong, Bushra Alam, Fang Liu

items.title: Do LLM Proposers Improve Budgeted Search for Ionizable Lipids?
items.abstract_or_text: Efficient lipid design under limited experimental budgets is a central challenge in computational chemistry and drug discovery. We introduce LEAF (Lipid Evolutionary Adaptive Framework), a matched-budget protocol for testing whether language-model proposers improve combinatorial molecular search relative to classical baselines. The study uses a 30,044-candidate ionizable-lipid space, a frozen Gaussian-process oracle fitted to experimental potency labels, and a separate active-learning surrogate. Four language models evaluated over eight seeds and three splits show no significant improvement over genetic-algorithm or random-search baselines. For Llama 8B, 79.1% of acquisition-selected queries repeat previously evaluated archive members. Removing duplicates reduces the performance gap on some splits but increases proposal cost and can prevent budget exhaustion. Larger models reduce duplication without establishing superiority or equivalence. Exploratory scored prompts and stricter novelty controls yield positive median differences against the genetic algorithm, yet wide intervals and shared-seed dependence preclude stronger conclusions. A validated single-assay reanalysis preserves the chemotype-cold deficit at a smaller numerical scale, and exploratory expected hypervolume improvement does not reverse the result. Follow-up checks address whether proposers genuinely use injected evidence. These checks include a zero-shot leakage probe, rank-only and chain-of-thought-rationale prompts, a score-shuffle perturbation, an evidence-conflict probe, and a genuine reasoning-mode proposer. They show measurable engagement with supplied information without a corresponding performance gain. LEAF isolates proposal quality as the experimental variable and documents a concrete failure mode of zero-shot LLM proposers under controlled budgets.
items.summary_zh: LEAF 在 30,044 个可离子化脂质候选空间中，以匹配预算比较四种语言模型提议器、遗传算法和随机搜索；语言模型未显著优于基线，且 Llama 8B 有 79.1% 查询重复历史候选。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提供了对零样本 LLM 分子提议器的严格负面评估，揭示重复查询和化学型冷启动不足等具体失败模式。结论依赖冻结 Gaussian-process oracle 和特定划分，不能直接等同于真实合成实验表现。
items.abstract_zh: 在实验预算有限的情况下高效设计脂质，是计算化学和药物发现中的核心挑战。我们提出 LEAF（Lipid Evolutionary Adaptive Framework），一种匹配预算的协议，用于检验语言模型提议器相对于经典基线是否能改进组合分子搜索。研究使用一个包含 30,044 个候选物的可离子化脂质空间、一个基于实验效力标签拟合的冻结 Gaussian-process oracle，以及一个独立的主动学习代理模型。四种语言模型在八个随机种子和三个划分上进行评估，结果显示其没有显著优于遗传算法或随机搜索基线。对于 Llama 8B，采集策略选中的查询中有 79.1% 重复了此前评估过的数据库成员。去除重复项会在一些划分上缩小性能差距，但增加提议成本，并可能导致预算无法用尽。更大的模型减少了重复，却没有证明其优越性或等价性。探索性评分提示和更严格的新颖性控制相对于遗传算法产生了正的中位数差异，但区间很宽，而且共享种子依赖性排除了更强的结论。经过验证的单测定重新分析在更小的数值规模上保留了 chemotype-cold 缺陷，探索性的期望超体积改进也没有逆转这一结果。后续检查评估提议器是否真正利用了注入的证据，包括零样本泄漏探测、仅排序提示和思维链理由提示、分数打乱扰动、证据冲突探测以及真正的推理模式提议器。这些检查显示，模型确实在可测量程度上使用了所提供的信息，但没有带来相应的性能提升。LEAF 将提议质量作为实验变量分离出来，并记录了受控预算下零样本 LLM 提议器的一种具体失败模式。

items.title: Thermoplastic polyurethane as a base material for soft, high-density neural interfaces
items.abstract_or_text: Polymers used as substrate and encapsulation for implantable devices are typically deposited layer-by-layer, leaving polymer-polymer interfaces that adhere poorly and become a critical failure point. Thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers combine four properties not found together in any other candidate: decades of clinical use in long-term implants and availability in medical grade, a stiffness well below that of polyimide and parylene C, compatibility with microfabrication, and thermoplastic self-fusion, which removes the polymer-polymer interface entirely. This work introduces TPU as a base material for soft, high-density neural interfaces and demonstrates one route to realizing them. Gold is patterned on a sacrificial copper sheet by maskless lithography and transferred into TPU by vacuum lamination, giving conformally coated tracks down to 15 um at 30 um pitch within a single, merged polymer body. An additional electroplating step produces a nanostructured pinecone gold surface that increases the electrochemically active area of the electrodes, approximately doubling the charge injection capacity. Daisy-chain silicon chips were also embedded within the soft polymer body. The films transmit up to 88% at 470 nm, a wavelength commonly used for optogenetics. TPU showed no cytotoxicity towards differentiated SH-SY5Y cells and only a mild tissue response after 9.5 months of subcutaneous implantation in rats.
items.summary_zh: 以 thermoplastic polyurethane（TPU）为软性高密度神经接口基材，通过无掩模光刻、真空层压和纳米结构金电极实现 15 μm 轨迹/30 μm 间距；电化学注入容量约翻倍，细胞和大鼠植入实验显示初步生物相容性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把临床使用基础、低刚度、微加工兼容性和热塑自融合结合到同一神经接口材料中，并给出 9.5 个月动物植入证据。仍需更长期、更大规模的植入稳定性和电性能验证。
items.abstract_zh: 用于植入式器件基底和封装的聚合物通常按层沉积，留下黏附性较差的聚合物-聚合物界面，并成为关键失效点。热塑性聚氨酯（TPU）弹性体结合了其他候选材料无法同时具备的四种性质：数十年的长期植入临床使用历史和医用级材料可得性；远低于 polyimide 和 parylene C 的刚度；与微加工兼容；以及能够完全去除聚合物-聚合物界面的热塑自融合。本研究将 TPU 引入为软性高密度神经接口的基材，并展示了实现这类器件的一条路线。研究通过无掩模光刻在牺牲铜片上图案化金，再通过真空层压将其转移到 TPU 中，在单一融合的聚合物本体内形成轨迹宽度最低 15 μm、间距 30 μm 的共形涂覆。额外的电镀步骤形成纳米结构松果状金表面，使电极的电化学活性面积增加，并使电荷注入容量约翻倍。研究还将 daisy-chain silicon chips 嵌入软性聚合物本体。薄膜在 470 nm（常用于光遗传学的波长）处的透射率最高可达 88%。TPU 对分化的 SH-SY5Y 细胞未显示细胞毒性，在大鼠皮下植入 9.5 个月后也只引起轻微组织反应。

items.title: Can GPT Be Used as an Alternative Prediction Model to Traditional Machine Learning and Neural Networks on Low-Volume Clinical Data?
items.abstract_or_text: Background and Objective: Early and reliable disease prediction from structured clinical data remains challenging when datasets are small, highly imbalanced, and contain limited positive disease cases. Conventional machine learning (ML) and deep learning approaches often struggle to capture clinically meaningful relationships under such low-data representation conditions due to weak statistical associations between features and prediction targets. This study proposes a clinically grounded GPT2-based table-to-text framework for disease prediction using structured healthcare datasets, motivated by the contextual reasoning capability of GPT models to better capture clinically meaningful relationships when statistical learning alone becomes insufficient due to limited data availability. Methods & Materials: Structured clinical records were transformed into physician-style textual descriptions and enriched through GPT4-generated medical paraphrasing to improve minority-class representation while preserving clinical meaning. Both the original and generated clinical texts were used to fine-tune a GPT2 model across four public healthcare datasets, including heart disease, heart failure, chronic kidney disease, and thyroid cancer recurrence. Gradient-based explainable AI analysis was additionally incorporated to identify clinically important features influencing prediction outcomes. Results: The proposed framework demonstrated consistently strong predictive performance with average precision, specificity, sensitivity, and F1-score of 0.96, 0.97, 0.96, and 0.96, respectively. The model achieved improved sensitivity, stronger generalization, and more stable predictive behavior compared with traditional ML, deep learning, transformer-based, and GAN-augmented approaches. Importantly, the framework consistently emphasized clinically meaningful variables even under severe class imbalance where conventional ML and neural network models often struggled. Conclusions: The proposed GPT2-based table-to-text framework provides a practical and clinically interpretable approach for disease prediction from limited structured healthcare data. By integrating contextual clinical reasoning with explainable prediction mechanisms, the framework demonstrates strong potential for early risk detection, transparent clinical decision support, and reliable deployment in real-world low-resource healthcare environments.
items.summary_zh: 预印本；提出将结构化临床记录转写为医生风格文本，并用 GPT4 生成医学释义后微调 GPT2，在四个低样本、类别不平衡的疾病数据集上进行疾病预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 覆盖心脏病、心力衰竭、慢性肾病和甲状腺癌复发四类公开数据，报告了较高的平均 precision、specificity、sensitivity 和 F1-score；但仍是回顾性数据上的模型评估，不能替代前瞻性临床验证。
items.abstract_zh: 背景与目的：从结构化临床数据中进行早期且可靠的疾病预测仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在数据集较小、高度不平衡且疾病阳性病例有限时。在这种低数据表示条件下，传统机器学习（ML）和深度学习方法往往难以捕捉具有临床意义的关系，因为特征与预测目标之间的统计关联较弱。本研究提出一种以临床为基础、基于 GPT2 的表格到文本疾病预测框架，利用结构化医疗数据进行疾病预测；其动机是，当单纯统计学习因数据可用性有限而不足时，GPT 模型的上下文推理能力可能更好地捕捉临床意义上的关系。方法与材料：将结构化临床记录转换为医生风格的文本描述，并用 GPT4 生成的医学释义进行增强，以在保持临床含义的同时改善少数类表示。使用原始临床文本和生成的临床文本，在四个公开医疗数据集上微调 GPT2，包括心脏病、心力衰竭、慢性肾病和甲状腺癌复发。另加入基于梯度的可解释人工智能分析，以识别影响预测结果的重要临床特征。结果：所提出框架表现出持续较强的预测性能，平均 precision、specificity、sensitivity 和 F1-score 分别为 0.96、0.97、0.96 和 0.96。与传统 ML、深度学习、基于 transformer 的方法以及 GAN 增强方法相比，该模型获得了更高的 sensitivity、更强的泛化能力和更稳定的预测行为。重要的是，即使在类别严重不平衡、传统 ML 和神经网络模型往往表现不佳的情况下，该框架仍持续强调具有临床意义的变量。结论：基于 GPT2 的表格到文本框架为从有限结构化临床数据进行疾病预测提供了一种实用且可解释的方案。通过将上下文临床推理与可解释预测机制结合，该框架显示出用于早期风险检测、透明的临床决策支持以及在真实低资源医疗环境中可靠部署的潜力。

items.title: Application of Bayesian-Derived Gene Interaction Network and Subnetwork for Classification of Idiopathic Parkinson Disease with Biomarkers
items.abstract_or_text: Given the expenses associated with Parkinson Disease (PD), it is imperative to develop a method for accurate diagnosis before emergence of motor symptoms. While there are tests that can measure early onset of PD, these tests still rely on subjective input from patients and can thus be biased. Factors influencing their accuracy include environmental agents such as education and culture. Thus, blood-based transcriptomic signatures are a promising direction for biomarkers in PD that are minimally invasive and more objective than clinical evaluation. In this paper, we analyzed gene expression from the PPMI cohort. Using a Bayesian framework, a gene interaction network was constructed to enhance differential expressed genes (DEG) analysis through signal diffusion. In tandem with clinical traits, 13 genes were selected for optimal discrimination using a random forest model. Within the holdout test set, the model achieved an AUC of 0.972, outperforming contemporary models. The model performance demonstrates the potential of using blood-based transcriptomics to enhance clinical diagnosis of PD. Other genes recovered by network diffusion but missed by traditional DEG analysis are already validated as potential biomarkers in contemporary PD research. By combining transcriptomic signatures with clinical evaluation, accurate diagnosis of PD can happen before the major destruction of dopaminergic neurons, which is critical for effective intervention and treatment.
items.summary_zh: 预印本；在 PPMI 队列血液转录组上用 Bayesian gene interaction network 进行信号扩散，并结合临床特征和 random forest 筛选 13 个 Parkinson Disease 生物标志物基因。
items.why_it_matters_zh: holdout test set 的 AUC 为 0.972，提示网络扩散可能补充传统 DEG 分析；但摘要只报告模型层面的诊断表现，尚不能证明可在运动症状出现前实现临床诊断或改善治疗结局。
items.abstract_zh: 鉴于 Parkinson Disease（PD）相关费用高昂，在运动症状出现前建立准确的诊断方法十分必要。尽管已有检测可以测量 PD 的早期发生，但这些检测仍依赖患者的主观输入，因此可能存在偏倚。教育和文化等环境因素也会影响其准确性。因此，血液转录组特征是有前景的生物标志物方向：它们具有微创性，并且比临床评估更客观。在本文中，我们分析了 PPMI 队列的基因表达数据。我们使用 Bayesian 框架构建基因相互作用网络，通过信号扩散增强差异表达基因（DEG）分析。同时结合临床特征，使用 random forest 选择了最具区分能力的 13 个基因。在 holdout test set 中，该模型达到 0.972 的 AUC，优于同期模型。模型表现显示，血液转录组与临床评估结合，有望增强 PD 的临床诊断。网络扩散找回、但传统 DEG 分析遗漏的其他基因，已经在当代 PD 研究中被验证为潜在生物标志物。将转录组特征与临床评估结合，可能在多巴胺能神经元发生大规模破坏之前实现准确诊断，这对有效干预和治疗至关重要。

items.title: Enhancing molecular and genomic approaches for Bordetella pertussis investigation and public health surveillance in Victoria, Australia
items.abstract_or_text: Bordetella pertussis is the main aetiological agent of pertussis (whooping cough), with a global resurgence of cases reported in 2024. As current pertussis diagnostics are predominantly based on molecular methods, cultured isolates are increasingly scarce, limiting traditional culture-based surveillance. To address these challenges, this study evaluated culture-independent approaches for B. pertussis surveillance and their feasibility for implementation in public health laboratory settings in Victoria, Australia. The Microbiological Diagnostic Unit Public Health Laboratory received 356 nasopharyngeal clinical specimens that were PCR-positive for Bordetella spp. from diagnostic laboratories for further characterisation during the 2024-2025 epidemic period. Culture-based approaches yielded only five B. pertussis isolates, largely due to limitations associated with specimen transport media. Four culture-independent approaches were evaluated for B. pertussis characterisation: real-time PCR assay for high-resolution Bordetella spp. differentiation (n=356), multiplex PCR amplicon sequencing assay for lineage typing (n=38), in-house laboratory developed test implemented on Panther Fusion(R) System for macrolide resistance screening (n=92) and shotgun metagenomic sequencing (n=5). The dataset was dominated by B. pertussis (330/356; 92.7%) with most strains harbouring ptxP3 (35/38; 92.1%) allele and the macrolide resistance rate was reported as 4.3% (4/92). Shotgun metagenomics was able to detect B. pertussis directly from clinical samples, but the genomic recovery was limited. Evaluation of operational performance and workflow integration highlighted method-specific strengths and limitations, informing suitability for implementation in public health laboratories. This study demonstrates the potential to integrate culture-independent approaches into public health laboratory settings to strengthen B. pertussis surveillance and inform feasible workflow design amid limited culture availability.
items.summary_zh: 预印本；在 Victoria, Australia 的 2024–2025 百日咳疫情期间评估 culture-independent PCR、amplicon sequencing、耐药筛查和 shotgun metagenomics 的公共卫生监测可行性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 基于 356 份 PCR 阳性鼻咽临床样本，比较了多种分子和基因组工作流，并明确报告培养分离不足和宏基因组回收受限等实施边界，对实验室监测流程设计有直接参考价值。
items.abstract_zh: Bordetella pertussis 是百日咳的主要病原体，2024 年全球报告病例再次增加。由于当前百日咳诊断主要依赖分子方法，培养分离株日益稀缺，限制了传统的基于培养的监测。为应对这些挑战，本研究评估了不依赖培养的 B. pertussis 监测方法，以及它们在 Australia, Victoria 公共卫生实验室中的实施可行性。在 2024–2025 年疫情期间，Microbiological Diagnostic Unit Public Health Laboratory 从诊断实验室接收了 356 份 Bordetella spp. PCR 阳性的鼻咽临床样本，以作进一步表征。由于样本运输培养基的限制，基于培养的方法只获得了 5 株 B. pertussis。研究评估了四种不依赖培养的 B. pertussis 表征方法：用于高分辨率 Bordetella spp. 区分的 real-time PCR assay（n=356）；用于谱系分型的 multiplex PCR amplicon sequencing assay（n=38）；在 Panther Fusion(R) System 上实施的实验室自建检测，用于 macrolide resistance screening（n=92）；以及 shotgun metagenomic sequencing（n=5）。数据集主要由 B. pertussis 构成（330/356；92.7%），多数菌株携带 ptxP3（35/38；92.1%）等位基因，macrolide resistance rate 为 4.3%（4/92）。Shotgun metagenomics 能够直接从临床样本中检测 B. pertussis，但基因组回收率有限。对运行性能和工作流整合的评估显示了不同方法的优势与局限，为其在公共卫生实验室中的适用性提供了信息。在培养可获得性有限的情况下，本研究展示了将不依赖培养的方法整合进公共卫生实验室、以加强 B. pertussis 监测并设计可行工作流的潜力。

items.title: IVA, a locally deployable Intelligent Variant Analyser based on a small language model for complete case-level and trio-based genomic interpretation.
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Recent work has brought large language models (LLMs) into clinical variant interpretation. In most existing approaches, the model is confined to text-level operations, retrieving, extracting, compacting, and summarizing heterogeneous evidence, while the genuine genetic evaluation is delegated to a separate deterministic engine. Other tools employ LLMs to mine functional evidence for a single ACMG criterion, to rerank a classifier's output, or to answer isolated variant questions. Integrative genetic reasoning, by contrast, demands multi-source evidence weighing for each variant, reconciliation of inheritance with observed zygosity and parental genotypes, joint interpretation of variants in the same gene, and the derivation of a case-level conclusion. Moreover, to protect patient privacy, this must be done on hospital premises. Methods: o build an end-to-end variant interpreter that runs on local infrastructure, we benchmarked 13 small language models (SLMs) on 150 multiple-choice genetics questions and selected Qwen3.5-9B. In IVA (Intelligent Variant Analyser), a four-stage pipeline, the model assigns ACMG/AMP criteria, applies de novo, dominant, recessive, and X-linked inheritance logic to trios, and writes a structured report, while deterministic code handles retrieval, phasing, point summation, citation checking, and formatting. We evaluated IVA on synthetic scenarios, 16 solved trios, and 327 solved singleton cases of visual impairment, on a single GPU. Results: On the benchmark, Qwen3.5-9B reached a mean accuracy of 0.81, compared with 0.89 for a 1.6-trillion-parameter cloud model. In the 16 trios, IVA reported every previously identified pathogenic, likely pathogenic, or uncertain-significance variant of interest (sensitivity 100%; precision 39.5%). In the 327 singleton cases, it recovered 93% of the expert-reported causative variants and classified 82% of them as pathogenic or likely pathogenic (precision 43%). Failures fell into four recurrent classes: omission, unverified mechanism, mismatch between reasoning and label, and arithmetic errors. Conclusions: A small language model running on local hardware can serve as the reasoning layer for case-level and trio-based variant interpretation when it is surrounded by deterministic safeguards. Because its outputs are not deterministic, analyst review and prospective multicenter validation remain necessary.
items.summary_zh: 预印本；IVA 将 Qwen3.5-9B 作为本地运行的遗传学推理层，用确定性代码完成检索、phasing、ACMG/AMP 计分、引用核验和格式化，支持 singleton 与 trio 的病例级变异解读。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 16 个已解决 trio 和 327 个视觉障碍 singleton 病例上报告 sensitivity、precision 和失败类型，显示本地小模型加确定性护栏的可行性；摘要明确要求分析员复核和前瞻性多中心验证。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：近期研究已将大型语言模型（LLM）引入临床变异解读。在大多数现有方法中，模型被限制在文本层面的操作，即检索、提取、压缩和总结异质证据，而真正的遗传学评估由另一个确定性引擎完成。其他工具使用 LLM 为单个 ACMG 标准挖掘功能证据、重新排序分类器输出，或回答孤立的变异问题。相比之下，整合性遗传推理要求对每个变异的多源证据进行权衡，将遗传方式与观察到的合子状态和父母基因型相协调，联合解读同一基因中的变异，并得出病例级结论。此外，为保护患者隐私，这一过程必须在医院本地完成。方法：为构建可在本地基础设施上运行的端到端变异解读器，我们对 13 个小型语言模型（SLM）进行了 150 道遗传学选择题的基准测试，并选择 Qwen3.5-9B。在 IVA（Intelligent Variant Analyser）中，四阶段流程由模型分配 ACMG/AMP 标准，对 trio 应用 de novo、dominant、recessive 和 X-linked 遗传逻辑，并撰写结构化报告；确定性代码负责检索、phasing、计分、引用核验和格式化。我们在合成场景、16 个已解决的 trio 病例以及 327 个已解决的视觉障碍 singleton 病例上进行了评估，运行于单个 GPU。结果：在基准测试中，Qwen3.5-9B 的平均准确率为 0.81，而一个拥有 1.6-trillion parameters 的云端模型为 0.89。在 16 个 trio 中，IVA 报告了所有此前确认的 pathogenic、likely pathogenic 或 uncertain-significance 重点变异（sensitivity 100%；precision 39.5%）。在 327 个 singleton 病例中，它找回了专家报告的致病原因变异的 93%，并将其中 82% 分类为 pathogenic 或 likely pathogenic（precision 43%）。失败归为四类：遗漏、未经核实的机制、推理与标签不匹配，以及算术错误。结论：当本地硬件运行的小型语言模型受到确定性护栏包围时，可以充当病例级和 trio 级变异解读的推理层。由于其输出并非确定性的，仍然需要分析员复核和前瞻性多中心验证。

items.title: Automated Variant Prioritization in Suspected Genetic Kidney Disease
items.abstract_or_text: Introduction Despite the identification of >700 genes associated with inherited kidney disease, many affected individuals presumably remain genetically undiagnosed through testing of known disease genes. Novel disease gene discovery requires interpretation of large-scale sequencing data, which remains challenging. Methods We developed the Nephro Candidate Score (N-CS), a machine learning (ML) framework for variant prioritization combining a Nephro Gene Score (N-GS), Nephro Variant Score (N-VS), and heuristic Inheritance Score. The ML-based N-GS and N-VS predict gene-disease relevance and variant pathogenicity from diverse genomic features. Clinical utility was assessed in 1452 individuals with suspected inherited kidney disease using exome-wide candidate discovery and gene-level burden analysis, with external validation using recently proposed inherited kidney disease genes. Results The N-CS showed strong predictive performance, with the XGBoost-based N-GS achieving an AUC of 0.94 and the Logistic Regression-based N-VS an AUC of 0.99 on independent test sets. A gene set enrichment analysis demonstrated significant enrichment of kidney-related biological processes among top-ranked genes (p < 0.001). In our patient cohort, N-CS-guided variant filtering recovered established disease genes and highlighted ERMP1 as a compelling candidate. Incorporating the N-GS in a polycystic kidney disease burden analysis reduced multiple-testing penalties, highlighting a moderate-effect candidate. Externally, the N-CS assigned high scores to 10 of 11 newly proposed kidney disease genes. Conclusion The N-CS is a digital framework to accelerate disease gene discovery and diagnosis. It is freely available as the NC-Scorer web tool (https://nc-scorer.kidney-genetics.org/) and a command-line interface enabling standardized, scalable candidate variant evaluation.
items.summary_zh: 预印本；Nephro Candidate Score 将 gene relevance、variant pathogenicity 和 inheritance heuristic 组合，用于遗传性肾病 exome-wide 候选优先级排序。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 1452 名疑似遗传性肾病个体上评估，并以独立测试集和 11 个新近提出的肾病基因进行外部验证；工具公开为 NC-Scorer web tool 和命令行接口，但 ERMP1 等候选仍需实验和临床确认。
items.abstract_zh: 引言：尽管已经发现了与遗传性肾病相关的基因超过 700 个，但许多患者可能仍因只检测已知疾病基因而未能获得遗传学诊断。发现新的疾病基因需要解读大规模测序数据，这仍然具有挑战性。方法：我们开发了 Nephro Candidate Score（N-CS），一种用于变异优先级排序的机器学习（ML）框架，结合 Nephro Gene Score（N-GS）、Nephro Variant Score（N-VS）和启发式 Inheritance Score。基于 ML 的 N-GS 和 N-VS 从多种基因组特征预测基因-疾病相关性和变异致病性。我们在 1452 名疑似遗传性肾病个体中，通过全外显子组候选发现和基因水平负荷分析评估临床实用性，并使用近期提出的遗传性肾病基因进行外部验证。结果：N-CS 表现出较强的预测性能；基于 XGBoost 的 N-GS 在独立测试集上的 AUC 为 0.94，基于 Logistic Regression 的 N-VS 的 AUC 为 0.99。基因集富集分析显示，排名靠前的基因显著富集于肾脏相关生物过程（p < 0.001）。在患者队列中，由 N-CS 指导的变异过滤找回了已知疾病基因，并突出显示 ERMP1 是一个有说服力的候选基因。在多囊肾病负荷分析中加入 N-GS 后，减少了多重检验惩罚，并突出显示了一个中等效应候选基因。在外部数据中，N-CS 为 11 个新近提出的肾病基因中的 10 个赋予了高分。结论：N-CS 是一个可加速疾病基因发现和诊断的数字框架。它以 NC-Scorer web tool 和命令行接口的形式免费提供，可进行标准化、可扩展的候选变异评估。

items.title: BioMod: Biological Module Tokenization for Single-Cell Foundation Modeling
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell foundation models typically represent cells as flat sequences of individual genes, requiring higher-order biological organization to be inferred implicitly from sparse expression profiles. Similar to the evolution from character-level to semantic tokenization in natural language processing,we hypothesize that cellular states can be more efficiently represented using biologically meaningful intermediate units. Here we present BioMod, a 50-million-parameter single-cell foundation model that introduces biological modules as representation units between genes and cells. BioMod constructs an overlapping vocabulary of 660 biological modules derived from curated pathways and data-driven gene programs, replacing thousands of gene-level inputs with compact module representations. Pretrained on approximately 73 million human cells using high-ratio module masking with an asymmetric decoder, BioMod achieves state-of-the-art performance across cell-type annotation, zero-shot batch integration, perturbation-response prediction and drug-response forecasting while maintaining a compact architecture that enables efficient inference on a single GPU. Module-level analyses further demonstrate that BioMod captures biologically meaningful cellular programs and preserves pathway-level organization.
items.summary_zh: 预印本；BioMod 用 660 个由 curated pathways 和 data-driven gene programs 得到的 biological modules 作为基因与细胞之间的表示单元，构建 50-million-parameter 单细胞 foundation model。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在约 7300 万个人类细胞上预训练，并同时评估 cell-type annotation、zero-shot batch integration、perturbation-response prediction 和 drug-response forecasting，强调模块化表示的效率与可解释性。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞 foundation models 通常将细胞表示为由单个基因组成的平面序列，因此需要从稀疏表达谱中隐式推断更高阶的生物学组织。类似于自然语言处理中从字符级 tokenization 演进到语义 tokenization，我们假设，使用具有生物学意义的中间单元可以更高效地表示细胞状态。在此，我们提出 BioMod，一个 50-million-parameter 的单细胞 foundation model，引入 biological modules 作为位于基因与细胞之间的表示单元。BioMod 构建了一个包含 660 个 biological modules 的重叠词表，这些模块来自 curated pathways 和 data-driven gene programs；它用紧凑的模块表示替代数千个基因级输入。BioMod 在约 7300 万个人类细胞上进行预训练，采用高比例 module masking 和 asymmetric decoder。在保持紧凑架构、能够在单个 GPU 上高效推理的同时，BioMod 在 cell-type annotation、zero-shot batch integration、perturbation-response prediction 和 drug-response forecasting 上取得 state-of-the-art 性能。模块级分析进一步表明，BioMod 能捕捉具有生物学意义的细胞程序，并保持通路层级的组织结构。

items.title: Neurite Complexity and Plasticity Markers Track Synaptic Vesicle Density in the Living Human Brain: A Multimodal PET-MRI-EEG Study
items.abstract_or_text: Neuroplasticity, the brain's capacity to reorganise its structure and function, is a transdiagnostic feature across psychiatric and neurodegenerative diseases and a putative mechanism of action for pharmacological interventions. [11C]-UCBJ positron emission tomography (PET), which quantifies synaptic vesicle glycoprotein 2A (SV2A) density, offers the most direct in vivo measure of human synaptic density, but its relationship to complementary, more scalable neuroimaging measures of structural and functional plasticity remains uncharacterised. We combined [11C]-UCBJ PET, diffusion weighted imaging (DWI/NODDI), resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI), and electroencephalography (EEG)-based sensory tasks (roving mismatch negativity, MMN; visual long-term potentiation, vLTP) in 18 healthy volunteers to test the relationship between synaptic terminal SV2A density and complementary structural and functional neuroplasticity measures, and whether these relationships were reproducible following pharmacological challenge with ketamine (n = 11) or N,N-dimethyltryptamine (DMT; n = 7). There were no statistically significant differences in PET-derived SV2A binding potential (BPND), DWI-derived neurite orientation dispersion (ODI) and structural weighted degree (SWD), EEG-derived MMN repetition suppression, and late-phase vLTP P2 potentiation, 1 to 8 days following DMT and ketamine exposure compared to baseline. BPND was coupled with ODI across cortical regions before and after pharmacological challenge, and this relationship was tighter within visual, attentional, and frontoparietal control brain networks. SWD showed a weaker, more spatially restricted association with BPND, primarily in regions belonging to the limbic and visual brain networks, but was not replicated post-drug. No consistent association was found between BPND and functional weighted degree (FWD), derived from rs-fMRI, at baseline or after pharmacological challenge. Frontotemporal BPND was positively associated with MMN repetition suppression (r = 0.61), and occipital BPND with late-phase vLTP P2 potentiation (r = 0.54), with the MMN-BPND association replicating after pharmacological challenge (r = 0.49). These findings link synaptic terminal SV2A density in the living human brain to neurite architecture and the capacity for short-term and Hebbian-like long-term synaptic plasticity, while dissociating these relationships from generic functional connectivity and magnitude of sensory-evoked responses. These data provide cross-modal validation for DWI- and EEG-derived measures as biological indices and surrogate measures of human synaptic plasticity.
items.summary_zh: 预印本；以 [11C]-UCBJ PET 测量 SV2A 突触小泡密度，并与 DWI/NODDI、rs-fMRI 和 EEG 感觉任务在 18 名健康志愿者中进行多模态比较，另评估 ketamine 和 DMT 挑战后的可重复性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将体内突触终末 SV2A 密度与 neurite architecture 及部分 EEG 可塑性指标联系起来，同时报告未观察到多项药物前后显著差异；样本量小，结果应视为关联性生物标志物证据而非因果关系。
items.abstract_zh: 神经可塑性，即大脑重组其结构和功能的能力，是精神疾病和神经退行性疾病中的跨诊断特征，也是药理学干预可能发挥作用的机制。能够量化 synaptic vesicle glycoprotein 2A（SV2A）密度的 [11C]-UCBJ positron emission tomography（PET）提供了目前最直接的人体体内突触密度测量方法，但它与更具可扩展性的结构和功能可塑性成像指标之间的关系尚未得到表征。我们在 18 名健康志愿者中结合 [11C]-UCBJ PET、diffusion weighted imaging（DWI/NODDI）、静息态 functional magnetic resonance imaging（rs-fMRI）和基于 electroencephalography（EEG）的感觉任务（roving mismatch negativity，MMN；visual long-term potentiation，vLTP），检验突触终末 SV2A 密度与互补的结构和功能神经可塑性指标之间的关系，并检验这些关系在 ketamine（n=11）或 N,N-dimethyltryptamine（DMT；n=7）药理学挑战后是否可重复。与基线相比，在 DMT 和 ketamine 暴露后 1 至 8 天，PET 得到的 SV2A binding potential（BPND）、DWI 得到的 neurite orientation dispersion（ODI）和 structural weighted degree（SWD）、EEG 得到的 MMN repetition suppression 以及 late-phase vLTP P2 potentiation 均未出现统计学显著差异。在药理学挑战前后，BPND 与皮层区域的 ODI 相耦合，而且在视觉、注意和额顶控制脑网络内这种关系更紧密。SWD 与 BPND 的关联较弱且空间范围更受限，主要位于边缘和视觉脑网络所属区域，但在用药后未能重复。基线时或药理学挑战后，均未发现 BPND 与由 rs-fMRI 得到的 functional weighted degree（FWD）存在一致关联。额颞叶 BPND 与 MMN repetition suppression 呈正相关（r = 0.61），枕叶 BPND 与 late-phase vLTP P2 potentiation 呈正相关（r = 0.54）；MMN-BPND 关联在药理学挑战后得到重复（r = 0.49）。这些发现将活体人脑中的突触终末 SV2A 密度与 neurite architecture 以及短期和 Hebbian-like 长期突触可塑性能力联系起来，同时将这些关系与一般性 functional connectivity 及感觉诱发反应幅度区分开来。这些数据为 DWI 和 EEG 衍生测量作为人类突触可塑性的生物学指标和替代测量提供了跨模态验证。

items.title: Cross-database adaptation of machine learning models for predicting sustained antibiotic exposure among patients with intracerebral hemorrhage in intensive care units
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Patients with intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH) in intensive care units (ICUs) frequently receive antibiotics early in critical illness. Such exposure reflects suspected infection, physiological deterioration, monitoring intensity, and clinical management and may vary across institutions and electronic health record databases. We evaluated target-domain adaptation for modeling sustained antibiotic exposure in critically ill patients with ICH. Methods: We analyzed derived ICH cohorts from MIMIC-IV and the eICU Collaborative Research Database. MIMIC-IV included 2,024 ICU stays and served as the source cohort. The eICU cohort comprised 1,277 stays and was divided, at the ICU-stay level, into a development subset (766 stays) and a held-out evaluation subset (511 stays). The eICU outcome was sustained antibiotic exposure on at least two ICU days. Candidate models incorporated demographic, comorbidity, physiological, laboratory, neurologic, respiratory, temporal, and measurement-process features. Timestamped observations for static and temporal tabular families were censored at the recorded first-antibiotic time when available, whereas the compact sequence component and explicit measurement-density features used the full first 24 hours. For base-model families using eICU development data, meta-learner inputs were generated by five-fold stratified cross-fitting. A 42-input L2-penalized logistic meta-learner combined 16 model probabilities with model-summary, clinical, availability, and measurement-density features. Results: The held-out eICU subset contained 48 positive outcomes (9.39%). The adapted ensemble achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.841 (95% CI 0.775-0.899) and an average precision (AP) of 0.540 (95% CI 0.399-0.676), with a Brier score of 0.063 and expected calibration error of 0.029. The MIMIC-IV source-only stack achieved an AUROC of 0.782; the paired AUROC difference was 0.059 (95% CI 0.003-0.112). In a separate patient-grouped five-fold out-of-fold sensitivity analysis of 503 linked eICU stays, AUROC was 0.807 (95% CI 0.691-0.910). Conclusions: Target-domain adaptation improved held-out discrimination relative to a source-only stack for sustained antibiotic exposure. Because some model components and measurement-process features used information from the broader first 24 hours, the model should be interpreted as a first-24-hour treatment-association model rather than a strictly prospective pre-treatment infection predictor.
items.summary_zh: 预印本；在 MIMIC-IV 与 eICU 数据库之间进行 target-domain adaptation，预测 intracerebral hemorrhage ICU 患者至少两个 ICU 日的持续抗生素暴露。
items.why_it_matters_zh: eICU 留出集包含 511 次 ICU stay，适配 ensemble 的 AUROC 为 0.841，并优于 source-only stack；作者明确指出其使用首 24 小时信息，应解读为 treatment-association model，而非严格的治疗前感染预测器。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：intracerebral hemorrhage（ICH）重症监护病房（ICU）患者在危重病早期经常接受抗生素。这种暴露反映了疑似感染、生理恶化、监测强度和临床管理，并可能在不同机构和电子健康记录数据库之间有所不同。我们评估了用于建模危重 ICH 患者持续抗生素暴露的 target-domain adaptation。方法：我们分析了从 MIMIC-IV 和 eICU Collaborative Research Database 得到的 ICH 队列。MIMIC-IV 包含 2,024 次 ICU stay，作为 source cohort。eICU 队列包含 1,277 次 stay，并在 ICU-stay 层面分为 development subset（766 次 stay）和留出的 evaluation subset（511 次 stay）。eICU 结局定义为至少两个 ICU 日存在持续抗生素暴露。候选模型纳入人口学、合并症、生理、实验室、神经系统、呼吸、时间、测量过程和测量密度特征。对于静态和时间表格特征族，带时间戳的观测在可获得时于记录的首次抗生素时间进行删失；而 compact sequence component 和显式 measurement-density features 使用完整的首 24 小时数据。对于使用 eICU development data 的基础模型族，meta-learner 输入由五折分层 cross-fitting 生成。一个 42-input、L2-penalized logistic meta-learner 结合了 16 个模型概率、模型摘要、临床、可用性和测量密度特征。结果：留出的 eICU subset 包含 48 个阳性结局（9.39%）。适配后的 ensemble 达到 0.841 的 area under the receiver operating characteristic curve（AUROC；95% CI 0.775–0.899）和 0.540 的 average precision（AP；95% CI 0.399–0.676），Brier score 为 0.063，expected calibration error 为 0.029。MIMIC-IV source-only stack 的 AUROC 为 0.782；配对 AUROC 差异为 0.059（95% CI 0.003–0.112）。在单独的、按患者分组的 eICU 503 次关联 stay 五折 out-of-fold 敏感性分析中，AUROC 为 0.807（95% CI 0.691–0.910）。结论：相对于 source-only stack，target-domain adaptation 提高了留出数据上对持续抗生素暴露的区分能力。由于部分模型组件和 measurement-process features 使用了更广泛的首 24 小时信息，该模型应解释为首 24 小时的 treatment-association model，而不是严格意义上的治疗前感染预测器。

items.title: Lysosomal Glycosaminoglycan Catabolism Regulates Microglial Cell State in the Developing CNS
items.abstract_or_text: Remodeling of the extracellular matrix (ECM), a complex structural and signaling network of the nervous system, is essential for CNS development, plasticity, and injury responses, yet how individual neural cell types contribute to this process remains poorly understood. Here, we show that phagocytic clearance of glycosaminoglycans (GAGs), major components of the ECM, is an intrinsic function of microglia in the developing CNS. Our studies reveal an unexpected finding that impaired GAG clearance shifts microglia toward a non-homeostatic cell state seen in immature and disease-associated microglia (DAM), supporting a reciprocal relationship between the ECM and microglia. Using mouse models of Mucopolysaccharidosis VII, we examined the consequences of deleting {beta}-glucuronidase (GUSB), a lysosomal enzyme required for GAG degradation. Loss of GUSB causes early accumulation of undegraded chondroitin sulfate within microglial lysosomes, as confirmed by LC-MS analysis of intracellular GAGs isolated from cortical microglia. Single-cell RNA sequencing identified Gusb-null microglia as a distinct transcriptional population enriched for a core transcriptome shared by immature and disease-associated microglia. Together, these findings establish lysosomal GAG catabolism as a pathway that links ECM remodeling to the acquisition of adult homeostatic microglial identity during CNS development.
items.summary_zh: 预印本；在 Mucopolysaccharidosis VII 小鼠模型中显示，微胶质细胞通过溶酶体 GAG 分解参与发育中 CNS 的 ECM 重塑，GUSB 缺失会改变微胶质细胞状态。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结合 LC-MS 的细胞内 GAG 分析和 single-cell RNA sequencing，将 ECM 清除、GUSB、溶酶体积累与 immature/DAM 转录状态联系起来，提供了细胞类型特异的机制线索，但摘要未报告直接干预救援实验。
items.abstract_zh: 细胞外基质（ECM）是神经系统中复杂的结构和信号网络，其重塑对 CNS 发育、可塑性和损伤反应至关重要，但人们仍不清楚不同神经细胞类型如何参与这一过程。在这里，我们显示，对 glycosaminoglycans（GAGs）的吞噬性清除是发育中 CNS 微胶质细胞的一项内在功能。我们的研究发现，GAG 清除受损会使微胶质细胞转变为一种非稳态细胞状态，这种状态见于未成熟微胶质细胞和 disease-associated microglia（DAM），支持 ECM 与微胶质细胞之间存在相互关系。我们使用 Mucopolysaccharidosis VII 小鼠模型，研究删除 β-glucuronidase（GUSB）的后果；GUSB 是降解 GAG 所必需的溶酶体酶。GUSB 缺失导致未降解的 chondroitin sulfate 早期积累于微胶质细胞溶酶体中，这一点通过对从皮层微胶质细胞分离的细胞内 GAG 进行 LC-MS 分析得到证实。Single-cell RNA sequencing 将 Gusb-null 微胶质细胞识别为一个独特的转录群体，并发现其富集于未成熟微胶质细胞和 disease-associated microglia 共有的核心转录组。总之，这些发现确立了溶酶体 GAG 分解这一通路，将 ECM 重塑与 CNS 发育过程中成人稳态微胶质细胞身份的获得联系起来。

items.title: VirtualSkin integrates skin-cell identity with intervention-response prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Human skin atlases resolve a diverse set of cellular states, yet connecting these states to their responses to intervention remains difficult across independently sampled tissues. Here we present VirtualSkin, a cell language model that aligns skin transcriptomes with biological descriptions and supports intervention conditioned response prediction. We evaluated the model across independent atlas, disease, anatomical and perturbation cohorts, with donors, studies and perturbations withheld according to the experimental design. VirtualSkin improved inflammatory skin annotation by 0.056 macro F1 points and cell text retrieval by 0.12 Recall@10 points relative to the strongest corresponding comparators. The representation retained cell identity during study integration and transferred across ageing, systemic sclerosis, lymphoma and anatomical sites. Across five intervention cohorts, response prediction improved by 0.03 0.09 response-score points, with agreement at the levels of gene expression change, gene recovery and transcriptional programs. Paired tissue trajectories provided a complementary assessment in two donors per intervention. Component ablations and pairing controls localized the predictive contributions, while uncertainty estimates supported selective prediction under distribution shift. These results connect skin-cell recognition to intervention response prediction within a common evaluation framework and define the conditions under which predictions can inform experimental prioritization.
items.summary_zh: 预印本；VirtualSkin 将皮肤转录组与生物学描述对齐，并在跨 atlas、疾病、解剖部位和 perturbation 队列中预测 intervention response。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在独立数据和 donor/study/perturbation 留出设计下报告 annotation、retrieval 和 response-score 改善，并用 ablation、pairing control 和 uncertainty estimate 分析分布偏移下的选择性预测。
items.abstract_zh: 人类皮肤图谱解析了多样的细胞状态，但在独立采样的组织之间将这些状态与干预反应联系起来仍然困难。在这里，我们提出 VirtualSkin，这是一种 cell language model，将皮肤转录组与生物学描述对齐，并支持以干预为条件的反应预测。我们在独立的 atlas、疾病、解剖和 perturbation 队列中评估该模型，按照实验设计留出 donor、study 和 perturbation。与相应任务中最强的比较方法相比，VirtualSkin 将炎症性皮肤 annotation 提高了 0.056 个 macro F1 points，将细胞文本检索提高了 0.12 个 Recall@10 points。该表示在研究整合过程中保留了细胞身份，并能够迁移到 ageing、systemic sclerosis、lymphoma 和不同解剖部位。在五个 intervention 队列中，response prediction 提高了 0.03–0.09 个 response-score points，并在 gene expression change、gene recovery 和 transcriptional programs 层面表现出一致性。配对组织轨迹为两项干预中每项的两名供体提供了补充评估。Component ablations 和 pairing controls 定位了预测贡献，而 uncertainty estimates 支持分布偏移条件下的选择性预测。这些结果在统一的评估框架中将皮肤细胞识别与干预反应预测联系起来，并界定了预测结果可以用于实验优先级排序的条件。
